(c) split the taxonomy: 'too many requests' (burst 429) maps to short backoff + in-place retry, NEVER family bench or all-families checkpoint. Regression tests: a pane rendering wall-phrase FIXTURES with a succeeding probe must not 85 (the 2026-08-15 class); a pane with wall text AND a failing probe must 85 (real-wall preserved); the corroboration probe itself must be quota-cheap and timeout-bounded.
